title: Live updates: HYPE leads altcoin rally as bitcoin recovers toward $78,000
summary: Bitcoin recovered from $75,972 overnight to just below $78,000, a third straight day of gains.

title: SBI Group backs payments firm dtcpay in $25 million funding round
summary: Stablecoin payments company dtcpay completed a $25 million Series A funding round with a strategic investment from Japan’s SBI Group.

title: Iran’s Strait of Hormuz toll booth ran through a bitcoin exchange, U.S. says
summary: The U.S. Treasury sanctioned BitBank, a Tehran exchange it says moved hundreds of millions of dollars in bitcoin to the Revolutionary Guards and handled payments collected from ships buying passage through the world’s most important oil chokepoint.

title: Solana speeds up blocks by 17%, but transaction capacity stays the same
summary: The network is cutting its target slot time to 250 milliseconds, giving apps fresher blockchain data and validators shorter control windows while reducing the amount of work allowed in each slot.

title: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in 3 months. Other demand signals look weak, too.
summary: Corporate treasuries bought just 5,900 bitcoin in three months, while broader demand signals remain weak.
